clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Marion Call sends you to report to Mennet Carkad. He waits deep in the Rogues' Quarter, where promising operatives are tested for the Deathstalkers.

Marion Call has a summons for you from Mennet Carkad. In the Undercity, covert operatives draw the notice of higher leadership, and Marion passes along word when a scout or assassin is invited to report. The Forsaken's intelligence apparatus has a lethal reputation, so ignoring its orders is no real choice.

Mennet Carkad waits in the Rogues' Quarter, watching recruits and judging whether they are ready. Those who answer his call are tested for entry into the Deathstalkers, the Forsaken's feared arm of espionage and assassination. Obedience is the first test for anyone who seeks to serve the Dark Lady from the shadows.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend? Not quite what I was expecting, considering Carkad himself has taken an interest to you. Looks can be deceiving though, right?
Either way, you should go see him as soon as possible. You wouldn't want to know what happened to the last few that chose to ignore his summons.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm. No doubt you made your way here at first mention of my summons, yes? Of course. I would expect no less from a prospective Deathstalker.
